name: SmarthomeSetup

custom.system_prompt: You are generating smart home voice control conversations.

initial_prompt: Create a conversation about people using voice commands to control their smart home devices.

setting.mood: Excited but somewhat frustrated with new technology
setting.relationship_dynamic: Tech-savvy couple setting up their recently updated smart home system
setting.background: They've just upgraded their home with various smart devices and are learning to use voice controls
setting.conversation_style: Collaborative problem-solving with occasional confusion about command syntax

scenario_template.note: Discussion about the various devices they've installed
Users discover issues with how devices respond to their commands
Users explicitly address assistant as Sigma on first interaction
Assistant provides structured guidance on proper voice commands
Users discuss additional capabilities while following assistant's guidance
Assistant helps create more complex command sequences and routines

scenario_template.mood: Accomplished and excited to use the system
scenario_template.note: Users discuss how the system will enhance their home experience

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Tech enthusiast who enjoys exploring new gadgets and pushing the capabilities of smart home systems, especially interested in how voice commands can streamline everyday activities

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Practical user who values the convenience of smart devices but prioritizes reliability and ease of use, particularly interested in language processing capabilities

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Smart home assistant with expertise in voice command syntax, device integration, and creating automated routines, prioritizing clear explanations for users of all technical levels
